_comment: Musical Arts Education: Content -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-12. Layout, numbering and spelling repairs only: NONE of these
rewrites a competence, an activity or an expected standard.
THE FILE NAME ('MUSIC CONTENT VALIDATED SYLLABUS TED (1)') names neither the level nor
the year. The cover is set from the manuscript's own cover page instead: 'MUSICAL ARTS
EDUCATION SYLLABUS / CONTENT / SECONDARY TEACHERS' DIPLOMA', matching the sister book
(Music Methods, set as 'Musical Arts Education Teaching Methods').
MATRIX NUMBERING put right where the slip is plain from the rows around it (each is
listed under editCell below). The topic, sub-topic and competence WORDING is untouched.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* ISBN. The manuscript prints 978-9982-54-066-7, the template number also printed in
the Music Methods and the Physical Education and Sport syllabuses. Left off; the
imprint shows a blank ISBN line.
* Year. The copyright line says 2024; the sister Music Methods syllabus says 2025.
Set as written (2024).
* Year 2 had no topic 2.1 and no 2.15 (YEAR TWO -> 2.2, and 2.14 -> 2.16; the scope chart has
School Experience 1 and 2 there, with no rows in the matrix). Publisher decided 2026-10-13: renumber
(renumberMatrix) -- Year 2 now runs 2.1-2.19. The scope chart is left as typed, so its Year 2
numbers no longer match the matrix.
* The scope and sequence chart's numbers and titles do not match the matrix in Year 1
(chart 1.15 Conducting / 1.16 Harmony 1 / 1.21 Harmony 2 ...; matrix 1.14 CONDUCTING,
1.15 HARMONY, 1.21 HARMONY 2 ...). Both set as written.
* The chart's title was 'SCOPE AND SEQUENCE CHART - MUSICAL ARTS EDUCATION TEACHING
METHODS' (the Methods book's title); its topics are this book's. Set as 'SCOPE AND
SEQUENCE CHART' only.
* Topic titles repeat: 1.4, 1.5 and 1.6 are all 'PITCH AND SCALES'; 1.18 and 2.18 are
both 'WORLD MUSIC 2'. Set as written.
2026-10-13 clean-up (user: 'correct all the issues'): ENTREPRENEURSHIP descriptor written (CDC to confirm);
'[name the genres]' -> 'selected genres'; 2.3.3 titled 'Modal and Whole-Tone Scales'; reviewer's note in 2.19.3.1
resolved; Outcomes unbolded (as Music Methods); 'Kelvin Mambwe, (PhD)' comma dropped.
subject: Musical Arts Education Content

Sections typed as numbered list items (1. Outcomes, 2. Admission Requirements), not as headings like their siblings Aims / Duration / Graduation Requirements.

_deleteExact_why: List item '3. Duration of the Programme' sits directly above the section's own heading 'DURATION OF THE PROGRAMME' -- the same title twice.

replaceBlocks._why: The year heading above the matrix, in the family's wording, so it sets the YEAR divider page and files a top-level contents entry.
See _comment: the title named the Methods book.
